title: I wish to go to @The Festival, this sounds like a BLAST! #musicalthea...
transcript: We are officially getting Coachella for theater kids. And as somebody who's been to Coachella and is a theater kid, I cannot wait. And while, yes, we've had Elsie Fest in the past, that's only ever been one day and in the city. And while there's nothing like the city, sometimes you want a weekend in the country. The festival promises to be a three day long music festival in Kingston, New York, with a variety of musical theater performances. They're not going to be performing full musicals per se, but they are going to be doing themed shows, tributes to composers, a rent 30th anniversary concert. Tickets are going to go on sale on March 6th, starting at $375, but they only sell the three day pass, so you won't be able to buy individually as of right now. And while it doesn't look like there's going to be camping at this music festival, which is disappointing to me as somebody that loves some music festival camping, there are hotels in the area that are going to be offering shuttle service to and from the music venue. And like a music festival, there's going to be multiple music ages, art vendors, food vendors, activities during the day. I'm really excited to see what this ends up being. As somebody that loves a music festival environment, the. The price to get in is always a little steep, but I always find that I get my money's worth in the three days of Festivities. I mean, really, my only complaint is that it's in the middle of August, which is Edinburgh Fringe Month. But we'll make it work. We'll make it work.
classificationReason: 'The Festival' — a Coachella-style musical theater festival in Kingston, NY — is not a stage production on the list. General non-theater-production content.
